1.title: 86 minutes of paid-UGC alpha | Hector Serrano (Wispr Flow)
1.author: Lenny's Podcast
1.hook: Paid-UGC playbook at Wispr Flow: creator roster structure (50 creators, $500–600 ads/month), compensation models (% of ad spend vs GMV), hiring for marketing at AI companies, why YouTube packaging beats production quality, why "best marketers are allergic to AI output."

2.title: Gemini 4 Changed How Google Builds Products | Jaclyn Konzelmann
2.author: Peter Yang
2.hook: Google Labs product director discusses how Gemini 4 changed her PM workflow, decision-making on what to build, editorial standards to prevent AI slop in products, and which Labs experiments shipped into the Gemini app.

3.title: Retrofitting Old Factories for AI Won't Work | Adarsh Kulkarni
3.author: MTS
3.hook: Foundry Robotics founder discusses why retrofitting legacy factories fails vs building AI-orchestrated facilities from scratch; covers four-nines reliability requirement, 36-month deployment timelines, and prediction of 1M robots delivering 5B work hours in 3 years.

1.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Will Pull Away From Rivals | Stephen Grugett and Alex Masmej
1.author: MTS
1.hook: MNX founders discuss building a financial exchange for AI valuation futures and compute commodities; covers market mechanics of AI company differentiation, fast-takeoff risk pricing, and decentralized infrastructure security.

2.title: Why NVIDIA Hardware Struggles on Large Model Decode | Jason Goodison
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Cerebras-backed General Compute raised $100M Series A to build inference cloud on custom silicon; covers why GPU decode bottlenecks matter, open-source model inference economics, and real-time agent requirements.
